description: Free estimate for UK sole traders. Estimates Income Tax and Class 4 National Insurance on self-employed profit, the effective rate and a suggested monthly set-aside (total divided by 12), with the band-by-band working and payments on account worked out (including the first 31 January payment for someone in their first year). Supports England/Wales/Northern Ireland and Scotland.

annual_profit_gbp.description: Annual self-employed profit in pounds, after allowable expenses.

first_year_self_employed.description: True if this is the first year the person is self-employed. Then the headline includes the first 31 January payment, which includes the first payment on account.

other_taxed_income_gbp.description: Other taxed income in pounds, e.g. a salary, so the profit is placed in the right tax bands.

region.description: Where the person lives for Income Tax: england_wales_ni (default) or scotland.

name: estimate_tax_set_aside
title: Estimate tax to set aside
